Q.	X was obsessed with comets. From the Hôtel de Cluny in Paris, he started a catalog of the night sky, to help distinguish stationary objects from fast-moving ones like the comets he wanted to discover. He is credited with the discovery of 13 comets, but that is not why his name is known in astronomy. His catalog is; Andromeda gets the number 31 in his catalog. ID X. ‎
